mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT m.*, row_number() OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN category = 'DIRECT_MESSAGE' AND sender_kind = 'USER' AND broadcast = false THEN 'user:' || CASE WHEN sender_user_id = #{userId} THEN recipient_user_id ELSE sender_user_id END::text ELSE 'message:' || id::text END ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC ) AS conversation_row, bool_or(recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL) OVER ( PARTITION BY CASE WHEN category = 'DIRECT_MESSAGE' AND sender_kind = 'USER' AND broadcast = false THEN 'user:' || CASE WHEN sender_user_id = #{userId} THEN recipient_user_id ELSE sender_user_id END::text ELSE 'message:' || id::text END ) AS has_unread FROM user_messages m WHERE (recipient_user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND inbox_visible = true) OR (sender_user_id = #{userId} AND sender_kind = 'USER' AND category = 'DIRECT_MESSAGE' AND broadcast = false) ) conversations WHERE conversation_row = 1 AND has_unread = true ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
